request.summary: Create a highly configurable digital clock that treats the time as one hero element and remains balanced in compact, ultra-wide, square, landscape, and portrait Wallboard zones.
request.audience: Visitors, employees, and operational teams reading time at signage distance.
request.primaryGoal: Show the selected timezone immediately with a composition that intentionally fills every assigned zone instead of leaving a small centered clock in extreme aspect ratios.

assumptions: The app is static and requires no datasource.
Timezone values use IANA names and invalid values fall back to UTC without breaking rendering.
The clock uses a transparent-capable configurable panel and no external media.

surfaces.purpose: Balanced landscape clock with time, location, date, and timezone hierarchy.
Single-line signage strip using side metadata to keep the complete width intentional.
Small playlist tile prioritizing time without overflow.
Tall composition that splits hours and minutes into a large vertical hero.
Compact square clock with clear supporting metadata.

settings.purpose: Human-readable place label shown with the clock.
IANA timezone used for time and date formatting.
Selects compact, medium, or long date formatting.
Shows or hides the seconds value.
Shows or hides the formatted date.
Shows or hides the timezone label.
Adjusts the bounded hero scale without changing layout rules.
Controls panel opacity, including a transparent canvas mode.

states.expectation: Time remains centered and dominant when date, seconds, and timezone are hidden.
An invalid timezone falls back to UTC and remains production-looking.
A long place label truncates cleanly without changing the hero geometry.

behaviors.expectation: The rendered epoch-second advances once per second and the timer is removed when the widget is destroyed.
A configuration update changes the rendered timezone without remounting the app.
ResizeObserver switches between wide, standard, compact, and tall hero compositions.

visualReview.intent: A restrained broadcast clock with one unmistakable hero value and supporting metadata placed to make each signage ratio feel deliberately composed.
focus: Verify the portrait hour/minute split fills height without making metadata collide.
Verify the ultra-wide layout uses the full strip without stretching the time characters.
Verify seconds share the baseline cleanly and compact mode removes secondary content before shrinking the hero excessively.
